label: QPS (single thread)
hypothesis: measured (M4, same process, identical results, 2026-11-05): ranking from the mapped checkpoint is 1.5x to 1.9x slower than from the live store on all four corpora. Block-max MaxScore was slower than the exhaustive pass at k=100, and a larger hot-list budget doubles serving RSS
